controls.name: Pattern generation rate (ms)
controls.description: The rate or interval between each action in a generated pattern. If set too low, the generation will take a long time.

controls.name: Max change per tick (%)
controls.description: Determines the smoothness: the lower the value the smoother

controls.name: Pattern normalization
controls.description: Normalizes the pattern between MIN & MAX. Works for INTENSITY,INVERSE,SMOOTH pattern.
